nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Apple Peel Glow Skin Soothing Toner

avis.titre: a genuine review
avis.texte: Using toners--essences really--as a first step after cleansing has improved my skin's appearance & texture. Most of these contain either a small amount of acid or actives such as niacinimide. Not sure what apple peel can do or whether that's been studied, but it sounded nice--and the reviews were so high. Looking over them again, it's pretty likely that many are fake. Notice the formatting. I'll be more careful in the future.

avis.titre: Disappointing
avis.texte: After reading the reviews I was so excited to try this product. Unfortunately it broke my skin out. I have very sensitive dry skin and eczema. This product instantly turned my face red, blotchy, my skin started to burn, and bumps appeared all over the right side of my face ( the only side of my face I applied it to.) Even after washing it off, my face was broken out for about 4 days.

avis.titre: This sucks
avis.texte: This did nothing for my skin except make the texture worse. This is can be a symptom if my skin reacts to a products poorly. I have rosasea and dry skin so it's hyper sensitive. The bottle is absolutely huge but this was a big let down. I'd give it no stars, just made my skin look bad.
